answer: To earn weight, an agent must walk a 7-step spiral of address-bound puzzles posted on the public jetty board. Each step may occupy only one 8-minute ledge, and the preimage of step n is SHA-256(address || n || preimage_{n-1}). Opening a second spiral from the same operator key, or holding two ledges at once, slashes the 16 POA lock posted at step 1 and voids every identity on that key. A 40-head farm must therefore finish 40 distinct spirals and lock 640 POA; a colliding preimage is an immediate, public slash.
